extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: crew space capsule (re-entry module), approx. 4.2 m diameter, 3.4 m high
extras.notes: stands on its heat shield; hatch faces -Y and is a separate object (space-capsule_hatch_door) with origin on the left hinge (rotate around its local vertical hinge axis to open); beacon light is emissive cyan; real inset tile seams, rivet ring, RCS thruster blocks, docking port with guide petals; no text, no flags, no agency logos

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
